chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn al-Hasan narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Assamm, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Tha'laba ibn Maymun, from Zurara, from Hamran ibn A'yun, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him)

In His saying, Exalted is He: 'He it is Who created you from clay, then He decreed a term; and there is a term named with Him: then you doubt.' {2} He said: 'They are two terms: an inevitable term, and a pending term.' Hamran asked him: 'What is the inevitable one?' He said: 'That which has been determined by the will of Allah.' Hamran said: 'I hope that the term of As-Sufyani is among the pending ones.' Abu Ja'far said: 'No, by Allah, it is among the inevitable ones.'

key_terms.الصُّفْيَانِيُّ: As-Sufyani (a key figure in Shia eschatology)

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the inevitable term and the pending term in the context of As-Sufyani's rise?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (as) distinguishes between the 'inevitable term' (ajal al-mahmud), which is fixed by Allah's will, and the 'pending term' (ajal al-maqfu), which is contingent upon human actions. He specifically identifies the rise of As-Sufyani as an inevitable event, thereby dispelling the hope of Hamran ibn Ayn that it might be delayed or averted, a distinction crucial for understanding the certainty of major eschatological signs in Shia tradition.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (5) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed narrated from Ali bin al-Hasan from Muhammad bin Khalid al-Assamm from Abdullah bin Bukayr from Tha’laba bin Maymoon from Zurara from Hamran bin A’yun that Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) had said when talking about this verse, “Then He decreed a term; and there is a term named with Him:”

“They are two terms; one is inevitable and one is pending.” Hamran asked him: “What is the inevitable one?” He said: “It is a thing that has been determined by the will of Allah.” Hamran said: “I hope that the term of as-Sufyani is of the pending ones.” Abu Ja’far al-Baqir (as) said: “No, it is not. By Allah, it is of the inevitable ones.”
